retrievalProfile.description: A dark, industrial-horror composition featuring a tattooed male bust suspended by metal rods with a severed, sparking mechanical lower torso.

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, high-contrast portrait of a heavily tattooed man with blonde braids and glowing red eyes. His torso is severed at the chest, revealing internal mechanical components, hanging wires, and orange sparks, all suspended by vertical metal pipes against a pitch-black background.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical vertical pipes framing the central figure
Aggressive red brush-script title contrasting with dark background
Warm orange sparks at the base balancing the cool skin tones
Mechanical internal details contrasting with organic skin and tattoos
coreInvariants: Severed torso with exposed wiring and sparks

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central bust, filling the middle two-thirds of the frame vertically.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The face with glowing red eyes serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the aggressive red title at the top, down the face to the sparking mechanical base, then to the clean artist name at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black void surrounding the subject to emphasize isolation and intensity.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the pale skin/bright sparks and the deep black shadows; high saturation in the red accents.

letterConstructionRules: Rough, frayed edges simulating dry brush strokes
Inconsistent baseline for a chaotic feel
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'O' characters are often narrow and oval-shaped
Terminals end in sharp, needle-like points
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Aggressive, textured hand-lettering for the title paired with a clean, wide-tracked minimalist sans-serif for the artist name.

avoid: Centered alignment for the secondary 'mixtape' text

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the aggressive, distressed brush feel of the main title.
Provides the clean, geometric contrast needed for the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dark industrial portrait of a tattooed man with blonde braids and glowing red eyes. His torso should be severed at the mid-chest, revealing mechanical parts, wires, and bright orange sparks. He is suspended by four vertical metal pipes against a solid black background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, aggressive red brush-script title across the top. Add a smaller, white, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif name at the very bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the torso severed with visible mechanical parts?
Is the top text red and distressed?

adjustableVariables: Density of tattoos on the skin
Level of distress on the red lettering
mustRedesign: Avoid specific facial features of the reference to ensure a unique character
Do not replicate specific tattoo patterns; use generic tribal or script tattoos
Ensure the mechanical parts are generic industrial components

mustAchieve: Convincing integration of mechanical and organic parts

postGenerationChecks: Check for high contrast between subject and background
Verify the red eyes have a distinct glow effect
Ensure the mechanical base looks heavy and metallic
Confirm the sparks appear to be emitting light onto the torso
Validate the wide tracking of the bottom text
recipe.reuseFormula: Industrial Horror Portrait + Severed Mechanical Torso + Aggressive Brush Typography + High Contrast Black Background
